references.editorJudgement: New conviction for role in assassination of Haiti’s president; international political accountability despite US trial venue.

references.title: Indian driver wins $1.3m in life-changing lottery prize
references.excerpt: A truck driver's fortunes have changed overnight after he won a Diwali lottery in the northern Indian state of Punjab.
references.editorJudgement: Individual lottery win, human-interest coverage.

references.title: Trump greets 'my friend' Putin as pair shake hands
references.excerpt: The pair met ahead of a trilateral meeting later with Chinese leader Xi Jinping.
references.editorJudgement: Greeting/handshake clip adds no substantive diplomatic development beyond the separately reported summit.

references.title: ‘We don’t produce Neets’: the London school recognised at World’s Best School awards
references.excerpt: Swiss Cottage school for children with complex needs is place where ‘every child feels they belong’, education secretary says For Maria, the hardest part of having a child with complex needs has been the grief: mourning the life she had imagined for her son, for her family – and coming to terms with how lonely the reality of parenting him can be. “There are wonderful days but there are very hard ones too,” she added, tears coursing down her face.…
references.editorJudgement: Local school award/profile, no material new national education policy.
